body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Dexim(www.dexim.net) announced the launch of five new accessories 'P-Flip' to complement the iPod, iPhone and BlackBerry at CES Unveiled at CES 2010 in Las Vegas.

New products include solar-powered and Blackberry-compatible P-Flip foldable power pack and the DVA011 multi-functional power case for the iPod Nano 5G with a built-in speaker, antenna and flashlight.

Building upon the success of the recently-released P-flip foldable power dock for the iPod and iPhone, Dexim now offers both a solar-powered (DCA199) and a Blackberry-compatible (DCA152) version of the P-Flip. Each is capable of extending talk time up to eight hours, video or game time up to 15 hours and audio playing time up to 80 hours.

The P-Flip can flip horizontally or vertically for hands-free video viewing, or fold for easy storage. The DCA199 Solar-Powered P-Flip will start out at $79.90 and the DCA152 P-Flip for BlackBerry is listed at just $59.90.

To complement the new FM radio and video camera-equipped iPod Nano 5G, the multi-functional power case houses an antenna for better radio reception, a built-in flashlight for taking videos without appropriate light and a speaker for desktop listening. Unlike anything else on the market, the DVA011 is listed at just $49.90.
Additional new products include Dexim's DCA192 Single Docking Station and DCA166 Charging Car Mount, which are both listed at $29.90 and compatible with the latest iPod and iPhone models.
